extracted.intended_audience: Public relations practitioners and PRSA Phoenix members
extracted.subtask_short: PRSA code of ethics for PR practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: A local-chapter presentation of PRSA's Code of Ethics and decision-making guidelines for public relations professionals, outlining core values and step-by-step guidance for resolving ethical challenges with clients and organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core fundamental values
rubrics_metrics.description: This code sets out the guidelines built on core fundamental values such as advocacy, honesty, loyalty, professional development and objectivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These core values form the foundation for ethical practice and interaction with clients and the public; they are the normative basis for the subsequent principles and decision-making guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define the specific ethical issues or conflicts
rubrics_metrics.description: Define the specific ethical issues or conflicts that are present or may be emerging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin ethical analysis by clearly identifying what the ethical question or conflict actually is before considering solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify internal and external influencing factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify internal and external factors (i.e., legal, political, social, economic) that may influence the decisions that need to be made or the parties involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider constraints and pressures from law, politics, society, economics, and organizational dynamics when evaluating options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify the key values at play
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the key values at play in the situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map the situation to the core values (e.g., advocacy, honesty, loyalty, objectivity) to see which values are in tension and require balancing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify affected parties and professional obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the parties that will be affected by the decisions made and define the PR professional’s obligation to each relevant stakeholder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly enumerate stakeholders (clients, publics, employees, the media, etc.) and clarify the practitioner’s duties to each when choosing a course of action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select ethical principles to guide decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Select ethical principles to guide the decision-making process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose which of the profession’s principles and values should drive the decision, justifying why those principles are prioritized in this context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make and justify decisions, planning and impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Make the necessary decisions and justify the reasoning, planning and impact on the parties involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document and communicate the chosen action, the rationale, expected consequences, and how impacts on stakeholders were considered and mitigated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect and advance the free flow of accurate and truthful information
rubrics_metrics.description: Protect and advance the free flow of accurate and truthful information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize transparency and accuracy in communications; avoid misleading statements or withholding material facts that would impair public understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster informed decision making through open communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Foster informed decision making through open communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage timely, clear, and open dialogue so stakeholders can make informed choices; avoid obscuring information that affects decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect confidential and private information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respect client and stakeholder confidentiality and privacy obligations, and safeguard sensitive data unless disclosure is ethically or legally required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote healthy and fair competition among professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote healthy and fair competition among professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compete ethically, avoid denigrating competitors unfairly, and follow norms that maintain professional integrity within the industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify, disclose, and manage or remove conflicts that could compromise objectivity, loyalty, or the public interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen the public’s trust in the profession
rubrics_metrics.description: Work to strengthen the public’s trust in the profession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act in ways that build and preserve confidence in public relations as a profession—through honesty, accountability, and ethical conduct.
